candidates.statement: AD18 (plan P160; v2 _adapter_fixture 1325-1400, _adapter_case 1419-1522; adapter3 _derivation): with e/o mode PLAN, the fixture-only mode refusal fires first and yields X7. If that check were skipped, adapter3 would read the manifest, verify the upstream capture ([]), then call schema on the same empty B-BAD_PIN prefix, which returns X5, and refuse with X7 ("synthetic upstream schema baseline invalid"); derivation.json and upstream-observation.json are already in the freeze immutable_paths. The decision (verdict, causes [X5,X7], reader_state, flags, has_retained_error, synthetic_evidence) is therefore identical with and without the mode check, the same masking class that retired AD20. AD18 still attributes label preservation on failure (requested/verified=false/measured=false/manifest ref/nested kind), but disposition-v2 coverage row "adapter synthetic derivation" (D090) and plan P160 present it as fixture-only/early-mode refusal coverage. Suggested disposition: withdraw the mode-refusal attribution and record it as deferred behind a genuine passing upstream baseline (DF13 class); no count/wording re-pin.
candidates.suggested_disposition: Withdraw the PLAN-mode/fixture-only refusal attribution from AD18 coverage claims; keep AD18 only for label preservation on failure; record mode-refusal attribution as deferred behind a genuine passing upstream baseline (DF13 class). No count/wording/forwarding re-pin and no subject edit by this preparer.

locations.harness_v2: run() bootstrap handler 1649-1660; per-case handler 1698-1715; comment 1707-1708

candidates.statement: BaseException handlers in run() emit a compact line before re-raising (bootstrap handler v2 1649-1660: _emit then owned.close_since(0) then raise; per-case handler 1698-1715: _emit inside try/finally then raise). If _emit itself raises (for example a stdout OSError), that exception replaces the propagating module BaseException (kept only as __context__), contrary to the inline comment at 1707-1708; in the bootstrap handler owned.close_since(0) is then also skipped.
candidates.suggested_disposition: Guard the compact emit so that its own failure cannot replace the propagating BaseException (and close harness descriptors first in the bootstrap path); runtime behaviour otherwise unchanged.
